entries.title: Judges 18:1
segments: Those days; the times referred to in the preceding chapter.
Had not fallen unto them; it had been allotted to them, but they had not gotten possession of all of it.

entries.title: Judges 18:2
segments: Zorah, and--Eshtaol; towns or districts in the tribe of Dan.

Search the land; for a place to which a portion of the tribe might migrate. 
 
If men were as sensible of their spiritual wants as they are of their temporal, and as earnest and persevering in providing for them, they might all be made rich for eternity.

entries.title: Judges 18:3
segments:
Knew the voice of the young man; they were before acquainted with him, or knew from his speech who he was. 
 
  Makest; doest.

entries.title: Judges 18:5
segments: Wicked man often have some conviction of their dependence on God, and ask others to seek for them his blessing.

entries.title: Judges 18:6
segments: Before the Lord is your way; he regards it, and will prosper it.

entries.title: Judges 18:7
segments: Laish; a town or district in the north of Palestine, at the foot of mount Lebanon and near the source of the Jordan; called also Leshem,

. 
 
  No business with any man; no public connection or conversation with any people from whom they could expect protection and defence. 
 
Those who are without civil government are destitute of the means which God has appointed to restrain the wicked and encourage the good, and to protect the one from the aggressions of the other.

entries.title: Judges 18:9
segments: Power to take possession of a good land does not give men a right to it, nor is their success any evidence that God approves of their conduct.  He may in wrath suffer them to rob others, and that robbery may prepare the way for their own ruin.

entries.title: Judges 18:12
segments:
In; near. 
 
  Mahaneh-dan; the camp of Dan; the same place as that mentioned in

.  This encampment of the Danites took place before Samson's birth. 
 
  Behind; on the west side.

entries.title: Judges 18:14
segments:
Consider; whether it is not best for you to rob Micah of his images. 
 
Consideration and cool deliberate calculation in iniquity increase its guilt, and manifest great hardness of heart.

entries.title: Judges 18:17
segments: Rebellion against God and injustice towards men go together, and no ties of relationship or experience of kindness will lead the wicked ever to make it their object to do to others as they would that others should do to them.

entries.title: Judges 18:19
segments: Lay thy hand upon thy mouth; say nothing.

entries.title: Judges 18:20
segments: The great object of false teachers is worldly good; the prospect of this, though by conniving at and sharing in flagrant wickedness, makes them glad.

entries.title: Judges 18:21
segments:
The carriage; the baggage, consisting of such movables as men emigrating with their families must take with them. 
 
  Before them; in the front part of their train, that thus they might be secure against an attack on the part of Micah and his friends.

entries.title: Judges 18:24
segments: Idols can afford their worshippers no help; and were not the human mind awfully blinded, and the heart besotted by sin, no one would expect it from them.

entries.title: Judges 18:25
segments: Robbery prepares men for murder, and those who feel and act as if might gave right, will commit any enormity.

entries.title: Judges 18:28
segments:
Zidon; a populous city on the Mediterranean. 
 
  Beth-rehob; a place west of Laish.

entries.title: Judges 18:30
segments:
Set up the graven image; thus idolatry was first publicly established in Israel. 
 
Satan, in his worship, is willing men should use robbery for burnt-offerings; but Jehovah in his worship abhors it.  Idolatry begun by few may spread to many, and ultimately prove the ruin of all.
